digest.component_or_area: authorship batched-map transient recovery test fixture
propositions: Test oracle calls resolve_event_commit exactly once per equivalence assertion, but batched-side recovery from transient Git read causes one-shot per-event oracle to return None while batched resolver succeeds, breaking exact SHA comparison.
Production resolve_event_commit deliberately maps all Git errors, empty results, timeouts, and exceptions to None and must remain fail-closed; production callers depend on None as fail-closed signal.

Test-local bounded retry helper is needed for per-event equivalence oracle to match established five-attempt batched fixture retry behavior, returning only non-None SHA and raising with object-store diagnostics on persistent failure.
Injected transient (rc128, rc0/empty, or BlockingIOError(EAGAIN)) on per-event git-log call must recover on immediate identical retry and return exact non-None SHA matching batched resolver result.
All batched/per-event exact equivalence assertions in fixture module must route through shared bounded oracle helper without weakening SHA expectations or changing production source code.
